title: Florida's 18th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Florida's 18th Congressional District will be held on November 3, 2026, following a primary on August 18, 2026. Incumbent Rep. Scott Franklin (R), first elected in 2020, is seeking re-election. The district, which covers much of central Florida's Heartland region including Lakeland and Polk County, has been drawn under a new congressional map signed by Gov. Ron DeSantis that is expected to favor Republicans. Democratic candidate Curtis Gibson and nonpartisan candidate Deva Simmons are also on the general election ballot, though the Democratic primary between Gibson and Tiffanie Luong (who did not qualify) is effectively uncontested. The race takes place against the backdrop of Florida's redistricting litigation and a national focus on control of the U.S. House.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this specific race as of the research date. The district is rated Safe/Solid Republican by major nonpartisan forecasters.

candidates.name: Scott Franklin
candidates.summary: Scott Franklin is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Florida's 18th Congressional District, first elected in 2020. He is a former Naval Aviator who served 26 years in the U.S. Navy, retiring as a Commander, and previously led Lanier Upshaw insurance agency as President & CEO. Franklin serves on the House Appropriations Committee and chairs the Environment Subcommittee on the Science, Space, and Technology Committee.

candidates.name: Curtis Gibson
candidates.summary: Curtis Gibson is a Democratic candidate for U.S. House in Florida's 18th Congressional District. He previously served as a Lake Wales City Commissioner and ran for mayor of Lake Wales in 2022 and 2025. Gibson is a small business owner and former commissioner who advocates for veterans' healthcare improvements, economic opportunity, and community-focused representation.

candidates.name: Deva Simmons
candidates.summary: Deva Simmons is a candidate running as a No Party Affiliation (independent) candidate for U.S. House in Florida's 18th Congressional District. She has over 20 years of experience in education as a teacher and mentor, and has served on the board of the Boys & Girls Club of Lakeland. Simmons emphasizes affordable healthcare, rebuilding trust in government, and community-centered representation.

forecast.rationale: No public polls exist for this race, limiting confidence in specific margin estimates. However, the structural indicators are unambiguous: incumbent Scott Franklin (R) is a two-term incumbent seeking re-election in a district drawn under a map signed by Gov. Ron DeSantis that is expected to favor Republicans. The district is rated Safe/Solid Republican by major nonpartisan forecasters. Democratic nominee Curtis Gibson is a former Lake Wales city commissioner with a lower statewide profile, and independent Deva Simmons (No Party Affiliation) faces steep structural headwinds in a heavily Republican district. Absent any contrary polling or evidence of competitiveness, the race overwhelmingly favors the Republican incumbent.
